_about: Each fighter's animation profile (docs/animation/pose-pipeline.md section 9.25; docs/design/launch-pair-plan.md). shape: the key into data/anim/shapes.json, ragdoll_motion.json and joints.json (idle, flinch and body build). pose_profile: the numbers that turn the rival's wave 1 into this fighter's own for a strike slot that does not need its own silhouette (the reuse slots): read by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs when it derives a fighter's wave from wave 1, never at runtime, so the poses it writes are plain poses. hand_states: a hand state replaced by another (his hands are never claws). rise: units the hips are lifted out of a crouch of 8 or more (never above standing; in a lunge the rear foot has no slack). stance: scale of how far the front foot is planted (1.0 is off: 1.12 pulled the rear foot out of its reach). twist: gain on the spine's turn (rounder arcs). guard_raise: units the free hand is lifted (kicks: both hands). head_pitch: degrees added to the head's pitch (chin up, eyes on the rival). timing and arc: parked, not read yet: how the fighter's blows are timed and how wide his arcs run. waves: the pose waves that carry a fighter's strikes, entries and energy poses (strikes, entries, energy), and `more`: every other wave that is his (his finisher, taunts, blast presses and the rest, or the shared pair1). The rival has an identity profile: wave 1 is his own, the base the Protagonist's profile is applied to. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
